end.parentNote: Asha practised place value using 6042 and 8614, including thousands, hundreds, tens and ones. Diya worked through the idea that 4 tens means 40 and combined 6000 + 40 + 2 to write 6042; the place-value mix-up was still present later when they described 8614 as 8 + 6 + 1 + 4. At home, practise one number at a time by building it with thousands, hundreds, tens and ones, then writing its expanded form.
